candidate_id: monotonically increasing source draw ID within run namespace; globally unique across all ranks; rejected draws leave gaps in admitted tags
pending: FIFO immutable ID/radius; bounded position search may retry positions only
size_gate: continuous triangle Lipschitz upper/lower wall-distance certificate, including one-voxel clearance; ambiguous band causes explicit stop
position_search_failure: TRANSIENTLY_BLOCKED only after testing geometrically admissible points blocked by ACTIVE/newly admitted particles; no geometric witness tested within budget -> POSITION_SEARCH_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED

semantics.SOURCE_POPULATION: floor(target) controls source_drawn; size rejections consume source demand and remain visible in target-admitted deficit
semantics.ADMITTED_POPULATION: floor(target) controls admitted+pending; permanent rejections trigger distinct new source candidates, never replacement of pending size

timestep_order: update target cumulative using trial dt
collective native LAMMPS create_atoms with explicit IDs
gather/sort active state and actual LAMMPS neighbor list
continuous WALL_ONLY and pair swept safety
rollback: copy controller including position RNG, pending and counters; insert trial atoms before RK2; on rejection delete precisely new tags, assert original LAMMPS state unchanged, discard trial logs/controller and retry smaller dt; commit once only
injection_timestamp: at t_n, demand allocated for [t_n,t_n+dt]; joins both solves; maximum one accepted-step anticipation of continuous threshold
physics: R_bulk + R_bubble_bubble_excess; original rigid_math and frozen_flow unchanged
wall: WALL_ONLY geometric rejection, halve dt and retry; no physical wall force
wall_stall: if dt<1e-10 or retry budget24 exhausted, stop run; active and pending retained at last accepted time; no particle deleted to relieve congestion
exits: exact outward segment/cap-triangle intersection; PORT caps excluded from wall; inlet outward exit is backflow; no external velocity query at exited endpoint
nearwall: BIOLOGICAL_CORE_WALL nearest subset, surface_gap/radius<=0.2 at discrete accepted observation times; ENTER/LEAVE/RIGHT_CENSORED residence; diagnostic only, no adhesion
region_tie: shared edge can attain identical minimum distance in extension and surgery subsets; independent validator verifies distance to reported subset when closest triangle IDs differ
